tagline: 蔡司胶片相机，1964 年发布
description: 蔡司于1964年推出的胶片相机。配备Frontar。快门速度speeds 1/30 sec. with flash, 1/60 sec. for daylight。使用126 film cartridges。

specs.快门: speeds 1/30 sec. with flash, 1/60 sec. for daylight
specs.光圈: controlled by selenium photo cell: 1:6.3 to estimated 1:16
specs.取景器: telescope finder with red/green symbols for correct lighting
specs.英文简介: The Zeiss Ikon Ikomatic viewfinder cameras were made by Bilora for Zeiss Ikon.
